by occupation brought to casuality with\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n c\/o 2 episodes of seizures 3hrs back.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPt was apparently asymptomatic 6yrs back then he had a h\/o trauma for which he went to a local hospital and CT brain was done which came out to be normal. At that hospital he was diagnosed to be hypertensive and was put on amlodipine but patient was not on regular medication. \u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThen 1yr back he started having symptoms such as forgetfulness, difficulty thinking and understanding. During this time,on one day while he was working in his farm he\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n had giddiness and went to a hospital in nalgonda where he was said to be having low bp and medication was given for it. The next day at 6am in the morning he was showing altered behavior. So his son took him to nalgonda hospital where CT brain was done. They were told that he was having an infarct in the brain. He was also diagnosed to be having alzheimers. By evening he had left side weakness, slurring of speech, deviation of mouth, altered behaviour. He was put on\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n1)Tab.Rosutor Gold 10\/75\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n2) Tab.Topline forte\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n3)Tab.Donamen 5mg. \u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAfter using medication for 3days they went to a ayurvedic hospital and took treatment for 6months.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nDuring those 6 months his left sided hemiplegia got better. But after few days he had right sided weakness in both upper and lower limbs. They continued the treatment in that 6months.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nAfter 6 months as he was not getting any better, they visited another hospital in bhongiri where he was put on some (ayurvedic treatment along with peracetum and amlodipine from past 6months).\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThen 3 hours before coming to our hospital, while he was made to walk for mins he had first episode of seizure activity lasted for about 10minutes associated with up rolling of eyes. After 10mins 2nd episode lasted for 30mins having generalized tonic clonic seizure of both upper limbs and lower limbs associated with up rolling of eyes and frothing.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHistory of alcohol intake occasionally for 30years. History of smoking chuttas 3-4per day for 30years.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn advice of doctor pt stopped consuming alcohol and smoking 6 years back.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHistory of toddy intake 500ml -1litre per day occasionally since 40years\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo history of tb, diabetes, asthma,chronic kidney disease.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nOn presentation \u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGCS - 4\/15\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nFebrile - 103°F\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPulse - 75bpm,regula\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBP 140\/100 mm of hg\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRR 24 cpm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSpO2 94@5lit of o2\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGRBS 136mg\/dl\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCNS examination\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPower,sensory system and gait cannot be elicited\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTone :\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n UL LL\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRight increased normal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nLeft increased normal\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nReflexes:\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u0026nbsp;
